items.title: Bobby Shew interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 1, 2020
items.q: I recorded stuff with Elvis, I recorded with Neil Diamond

ctx.x: There’s no royalties in television. If I had, the shows that I did, like “Love Boat,” “Hawaii 5-0,” “Eight is Enough,” “Mork & Mindy,” the list goes on you would not believe it you know, if you saw the list of shows that I did. “Mission Impossible,” whatever. The list is ridiculous. And there’s no royalties paid on TV for musicians. Everybody else gets paid: the producers, the guy that mops the floor and goes out for sandwiches gets paid. But there was a problem going on with the AF of M years and years and years…
